paper_metadata.title: Effect of continuous gradient Al on high-temperature oxidation of Ni-Cr-Co based superalloys via a high-throughput method

evidence.quote: Ni-Cr-Co based superalloys
The high-temperature oxidation of Ni-Cr-Co based superalloys is a process of the selective oxidation of solute compositions (mainly Cr, Al, and Ti).
This study focuses on the influence of Al content on the oxidation resistance of Ni-Cr-Co based superalloys at 870 ◦C/100 h
